name: Hoarfrost Cheek
description: Elbows folded like a hawk's wings at rest, the user keeps the hatchet tucked against the body.

name: Bitruin
description: A swift chop from the shoulder lands with the sharp snap of a hawk's wing-tip.

name: Heelflash
description: A long low glide on the front foot carries the user across the gap without a visible stride.

name: Poll Havoc
description: Qi thins the edge to a feather's sharpness so the cut slides through cloth and leather easily.

name: Unbowed Handlenub
description: The hatchet sweeps out like a long wing feather and brushes an incoming blow clean off its line.

name: Beardnerve
description: The beard closes on the opponent's wrist like a talon and qi tightens the grip.

name: Lotbillet
description: Cut after cut rises and falls like wing-beats, each stroke lifting the user into the next.

name: Facet Splinter
description: After a gathering pause, a plunging cleave drives the whole field through one point of the guard.

name: Devastating Might Helve
description: Qi folds the user's step into a flash that places the hatchet behind the opponent's guard before it can turn.

name: Adamantine Eye
description: The guard hand holds the first track steady while the hatchet waits on the second.

name: Billetruin
description: Whatever the opponent does on the first track is answered with a chop on the second.

name: Numbing Cheek
description: Two quick raps run side by side along the opponent's weapon and shake the grip loose.

name: Pollblink
description: The feet move on two rails, one advancing as the other holds, so balance never leaves the user.

name: Beardwrath
description: One track sends the qi field along the edge and the other times the cut to land with it.

name: Equipoise Toe
description: The two tracks cross at the moment of contact, and the blow is turned where they meet.

name: Immobilizing Heel
description: The beard hooks on one track and a pull comes from the other, tripling the opponent's trouble.

name: Downpour Chock
description: Two broad sweeps of qi leave the hatchet side by side, covering the whole front of the user.

name: Multiplying Haftswell
description: Each opponent's move is met by a counter on one track while the other prepares the next.

name: Titanic Rumble Fell
description: Both tracks meet in one stroke that carries the whole qi field through the hatchet's edge and the guard before it.

name: Flintlike Haftswell
description: Standing like a bank holding back the water, the user braces the hatchet across the body.

name: Helvewrath
description: A low sweeping chop drags through the opponent's ankles like silt dragged along a bed.

name: Rumble Handlenub
description: Repeated raps lap against the opponent's guard like water on a bank.

name: Billetglare
description: Following a channel's course, the user flows around an obstacle rather than through it.

name: Toevalor
description: The beard dams the opponent's arm like a weir across a stream, and holds it back.

name: Kerfruin
description: Each successive cut carries more qi than the last, like water rising behind a dam.

name: Chime Haftswell
description: A parry as steady as a current turns the blow and keeps the user moving forward.

name: Maiming Eye
description: A patient, ever-heavier pull on the hooked arm presses the opponent's balance toward collapse.

name: Synchronized Chock
description: Hook, shove and chop mount in force as a flood mounts, until the guard can bear no more.

name: Shadehelve
description: A steady rain of short chops pins the opponent behind their guard and gives them no room to counter.

name: Tempered Billet
description: The whole pent-up field is released through the edge in one stroke that breaches a guard as a river breaches a bank.

name: Impervious Beard
description: Beard forward and edge back, the hatchet is held so either part can answer at once.

name: Cheekscourge
description: The edge cuts first, and the beard catches the wound as the hatchet withdraws.

name: Heelglimmer
description: Stepping in just as the beard sets, the user closes with the hook already placed.

name: Overbearing Bit
description: A hook pulls the opponent's guard open exactly where the following edge is aimed.

name: Heelwrath
description: A cut fixes the opponent's attention on the edge, and the beard slips behind the arm unseen.

name: Torrent Beard
description: A rolling turn of the head parries with the edge and finishes with the hook on the blade.

name: Escalating Fell
description: Hook, edge, hook, edge in a steady alternation wears down and then opens the opponent's guard.

name: Hollowbit
description: The beard and edge strike together at the same seam of armour and tear it open.

name: Punishing Granite Eye
description: With the field binding the hooked limb in place, the edge falls in the same breath and severs the guard.

name: Unconquered Toe
description: With the sun at its back the hatchet is held low, hiding its glint from the opponent.

name: Pollscourge
description: A chop thrown from the shadow side lands before the opponent can mark where it began.

name: Mayhem Beard
description: A rap from the unlit side jolts the weapon hand and draws the eyes the wrong way.

name: Chockvortex
description: Feeling the ground with the ball of the foot, the user advances along a path they cannot see.

name: Hogtying Kerf
description: The beard finds the opponent's arm by touch alone and pulls it close.

name: Cheekruin
description: The qi field marks where the opponent stands in the dark, and the edge follows it exactly.

name: Gust Bit
description: Feeling a blade's approach through the field, the user parries with eyes half closed.

name: Toxin Helve
description: A slow drawing pull, hidden in the failing light, takes the opponent off balance before they sense it.

name: Dazzling Fell
description: Backing into the deeper shadow, the user lets the dusk close over the withdrawal.

name: Intent Billet
description: Sensing the field around the opponent, the user strings hook, cut and shove through gaps the eyes cannot see.

name: Clairvoyant Eye
description: The field senses the opponent's unguarded flank and the cleave arrives there without any warning.

name: Hellish Handlenub
description: Qi lifts the user out of the light in a flash and the edge falls from the darkest quarter.

name: Obdurate Heel
description: Hatchets held crossed before the chest, the two hands guard each other's blind side.

name: Beardscourge
description: Two chops count out a beat, left then right, and the pause between them is the trap.

name: Toeblink
description: Steps are taken to the same count as the cuts, so body and hatchets move as one.

name: Chimekerf
description: Both beards snag the opponent's weapon from either side and wrench it sideways.

name: Blistering Chock
description: Qi flows into both hatchets at once, and the paired edges bite at slightly different heights.

name: Murk Eye
description: The two heads cross to catch a heavy blow and throw it high over the user's shoulder.

name: Harnessing Poll
description: One head hooks the arm from above and the other from below, locking the joint between them.

name: Reverberating Fell
description: A counted rhythm of left and right strokes grows quicker and heavier until the opponent loses the beat.

name: Novaheel
description: The two edges close on a limb or weapon from opposite sides like shears.

name: Sanguine Helve
description: With both hatchets moving as a single body, the qi field binds and cuts in one crossing stroke.

name: Inexorable Cheek
description: Each morning the grip is tested hard against a pull, and the same firm hold guards the body in a fight.

name: Bithavoc
description: A wide chop sweeps through the space before the user as if clearing a morning mist.

name: Eyeflash
description: Short flat-footed steps hold the ground against wet grass and keep the hatchet steady.

name: Overpowering Heel
description: A bright quick rap from low to high stings the opponent's wrist and lifts their weapon.

name: Fastening Poll
description: The beard draws the opponent's forearm down, slow and sure as the sun climbing.

name: Mightbit
description: With the grip warmed by qi, the cut leaves the hand smoother and faster than a cold one.

name: Equipoise Cheek
description: The head rises in a bright arc and flicks the opposing blade up and away.

name: Suffocating Beard
description: The beard darts out at the first moment of light between two strokes and snatches the opponent's wrist.

name: Overlapping Kerf
description: The full morning round of cut, hook, parry and shove is run through as one flowing combat sequence.

name: Daybreak Poll
description: The field is raised slowly like the dawn and released in one wide sweep ahead of the user.

name: Energizing Beard
description: The field floods the hatchet hand with strength, and one rising stroke lands with a full day's force.

name: Unbudging Handlenub
description: The user holds the hatchet as steadily as a promise, never shifting its line before the body.

name: Helvehavoc
description: A chop is thrown only when the wind sits right, in the sworn manner of the school.

name: Mastering Toe
description: A rap times itself to the opponent's breath, as a sailor times a gust.

name: Unseen Cheek
description: Pace follows pace, light as a gust, and the user arrives before the opponent expects.

name: Ironbit
description: Qi gathered on the windward side of the arm sends the cut with the wind at its back.

name: Chime Poll
description: The parry holds to its word, giving no ground until the incoming blade is past.

name: Ponderous Billet
description: The beard hooks and holds in the manner of a sworn pledge that cannot be shaken off.

name: Confluent Axehew
description: Every page of the oath-book is a cut, and they follow one another in the order sworn.

name: Charter Eye
description: Short cutting strokes come as thick as a gale's gusts and leave the opponent no moment to answer.

name: Rampaging Fell
description: At the first breath of wind the user flashes forward and the hatchet is already through.

name: Invincible Heel
description: The user fixes a bearing on the opponent's chest and holds the hatchet steady across it.

name: Beardruin
description: The chop runs straight down the taken bearing, unaffected by feints.

name: Phantom Cheek
description: A small shift of the feet moves the bearing a quarter turn, and with it the whole attack.

name: Wrathful Chock
description: Qi pours along the bearing already taken and the cut lands with no trace of waste.

name: Gust Poll
description: Turning the bearing aside a hand's width, the parry slides the blow off the user's line.

name: Hogtying Billet
description: The beard catches the opponent's arm and drags it onto the user's own bearing.

name: Multiplying Bit
description: One bearing is taken, a second follows, and a third closes the circle, each with its own cut.

name: Berserk Haftswell
description: The bearing is held through a long breath and the cleave is released along it at once.

name: Verity Cheek
description: The user's held bearing throws an incoming blow back along its own line, and the edge follows it home.

name: Indomitable Bit
description: Feet apart near a sheer drop, the user holds the hatchet across the body and leans against any gust.

name: Kerfwrath
description: Striking downhill, the user adds the weight of the slope to a plain chop.

name: Numbing Poll
description: A rap timed to a rising gust lifts the opponent's weapon arm higher than they intended.

name: Dazzling Toe
description: Quick, sliding steps across loose stone keep the user upright where the opponent slips.

name: Strangling Chock
description: The beard snatches an opponent's belt at the rim and holds on against the pull of the drop.

name: Unsparing Beard
description: A cut thrown with the rim wind at its back lands harder than the arm alone could throw it.

name: Torrent Poll
description: A sideways flick lets the crosswind push an opposing blade past the user's shoulder.

name: Rumbleheel
description: Standing uphill, the user hooks and pulls the opponent down the scarp with qi-aided strength.

name: Lightning Axehew
description: Backing along a ledge on the heels, the user trusts the ground behind without looking.

name: Escalating Beard
description: Cut, hook, shove and cut again follow like successive gusts over the plateau, each stronger than the last.

name: Glint Eye
description: After a brief gathering, a cleave drives qi into a single crack of the opponent's guard like frost into rock.

name: Granite Fell
description: One broad, wind-backed sweep sends qi across the open ground in front of the user.

name: Titanic Helve
description: Dropping from a height the user lets the whole fall and the field ride down the edge in a single stroke.

name: Unrelenting Cheek
description: With no wall at the side, the hatchet is held where it can cover either flank.

name: Hellish Bit
description: On open ground the chop is thrown in a full arc, nothing near enough to hinder it.

name: Overbearing Poll
description: A rap from any quarter of the compass makes the opponent guard against every side.

name: Meteoric Kerf
description: Stepping in a wide circle, the user keeps the opponent turning to face them.

name: Hogtying Heel
description: The free hand and beard together trap a limb, leaving the user's back open to no one.

name: Beardhavoc
description: Qi carries the cut in a full turn of the body, so that it lands from wherever the user stands.

name: Equipoise Poll
description: A quarter turn of the shoulders and the hatchet meets a blow from the flank and sends it past.

name: Maiming Chock
description: With room to move, the user hooks the arm and turns a full circle, flinging the opponent off line.

name: Synchronized Helve
description: Cuts come in turn from front, side and rear quarters until the opponent cannot tell where to guard.

name: Dismantling Bit
description: A single long sweep of the hatchet beneath the open sky sends qi across the ground ahead.

name: Booming Eye
description: The field senses an attacker at the user's back, and the hatchet is already turning to meet them.

name: Impenetrable Eye
description: Planted square to the wind, the user holds the hatchet as a sworn watch is held.

name: Ruinous Splinter
description: A single chop thrown only once the bearing is certain, as an oath is only given once.

name: Webbing Cheek
description: A hard rap to the sword hand binds the opponent's next stroke to one line only.

name: Vanishing Heel
description: One long pace, taken without hurry, covers ground and keeps the hatchet in guard.

name: Corroding Beard
description: Qi bound to the wind's direction gives the cut a steady push that does not tire the arm.

name: Chime Cheek
description: The parry is a turn of the whole frame, keeping faith with the guard's line.

name: Hoarfrost Eye
description: The beard binds the wrist, and qi in the grip makes the hold a vow that does not slip.

name: Lot Poll
description: Each stroke repeats the one before it a little harder, so the oath is kept again and again.

name: Brutalizing Fell
description: After a long breath that feeds qi into the grip, the cleave falls with the weight of a held promise.

name: Mangling Heel
description: The user seals the opponent's line of retreat with the field and cuts along the bearing so sworn.

name: Unassailable Bit
description: The hatchet is angled across the body to meet a blow from the side as a crosswind meets a sail.

name: Punishing Heel
description: A chop comes in from the side, sudden and flat, like a gust round a corner of rock.

name: Headlong Bit
description: A diagonal step crosses the opponent's line of attack at an angle and leaves them facing empty air.

name: Toewrath
description: Qi pushes the cut across the opponent's line, so the edge enters from where they are not watching.

name: Murk Poll
description: A sudden turn of the head, like a gust changing, bats the incoming blade off its course.

name: Suffocating Eye
description: The beard catches the arm from the side and pulls it across the opponent's own body.

name: Reverberating Heel
description: Cuts cross the opponent's guard from left, right and above in rising turns of the wind.

name: Rumble Axehew
description: Two crossing cuts meet at the same seam of a guard and shear it open.

name: Shattering Toe
description: In a flash across the opponent's line, the user draws one cut through the whole of the guard.

name: Flintlike Handlenub
description: Feet fixed on the bearing, the hatchet is held so steady that the opponent tires first.

name: Toehavoc
description: The chop is aimed at the point where the opponent's line of force changes direction.

name: Overpowering Cheek
description: The user holds position and raps a single sharp blow on the opponent's guard wrist.

name: Dazzling Poll
description: A step along the bearing, no wider than a foot, closes the distance by degrees.

name: Enthralling Beard
description: The beard breaks the opponent's grip on a weapon by catching the wrist at its weakest turn.

name: Bitscourge
description: With qi poured along the held line, the cut meets the opponent exactly where their guard rests.

name: Gust Haftswell
description: The parry takes the opponent's bearing and turns it a quarter, ruining their next stroke.

name: Numbing Billet
description: A hooked pull at the instant the opponent steps breaks their stride and tips them forward.

name: Torrential Beard
description: Giving ground along the bearing, the user loses distance but not the line.

name: Overlapping Helve
description: Long patient holds end in a sudden break, and the following cuts rush through the broken line.

name: Tempered Chock
description: The cleave is released after a held breath at the exact point where the opponent's line bends.

name: Shade Toe
description: One edge stroke breaks the opponent's bearing and the field presses their qi flow down behind it.
